result.summary: The application interface displays an unlocalized string in the 'home_feed.popular_title' section, which is a content/i18n bug.

issues.description: The title 'home_feed.popular_title' is clearly a hard-coded internal string key instead of the localized user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key 'home_feed.popular_title' with the appropriate localized string, such as 'Popular in your area'.
